note: Composed worlds for the longer surahs (pieces and hands-on activities). Written by scripts/compose-specs.py; no person, prophet, angel, Allah or unseen reality is shown.

2.concept: A green valley of guidance: an orchard where hidden things are found by name (2:31), a meadow of cows (2:67), great foundation stones (2:127), a river to cross (2:249) and a field where one seed grows seven spikes (2:261).

acts.name: Find the names
acts.desc: Find five glowing things hidden in the orchard.

acts.name: Lay the foundations
acts.desc: Carry four great stones to the foundations.

acts.name: Plant the seed of charity
acts.desc: Plant three seeds; each one grows seven spikes of grain.

3.concept: A sanctuary in morning light: a small chamber with fruit in a lit niche, no one shown (3:37), a courtyard of pillars bound by one rope (3:103), a rooftop where a sundial marks the turning of night and day (3:190) and a distant gateway (3:96).

acts.name: Hold the rope together
acts.desc: Carry four stones to the circle so the pillars stand together.
acts.label: together

4.concept: A village of trusts and justice: a square with one fountain from which channels run (4:1), houses waiting for what was lent to come back (4:58), a lane of neighbours (4:36) and tall scales (4:135).

acts.name: Return the trusts
acts.desc: Carry four chests back to the house they belong to.
acts.label: trusts

5.concept: A hall of promises (5:1), an olive grove where a crow scratches the ground (5:31), one lantern that lights a whole hall (5:32) and a long table under an arch, spread and empty (5:114).

acts.name: Help each other
acts.desc: Carry baskets of food to the hall to share.
acts.label: share

6.concept: A night of signs turning to dawn: a ridge where a bright star sets (6:76), a plain where the moon rises (6:77), an overlook at sunrise (6:78), a valley where seeds split and sprout (6:95) and date palms with low clusters (6:99).

acts.name: Split the seed
acts.desc: Plant three seeds and watch each split and sprout.

7.concept: The heights: a garden with one tree (7:19), timbers of a ship on a hill (7:64), wide windy plains (7:65), homes carved in cliffs (7:74), a market where weights must be fair (7:85) and a calm shore (7:138).

acts.name: Fair weights
acts.desc: Carry the brass weights to the scale, giving full measure.
acts.label: full measure

8.concept: A field where rain falls and the sand grows firm (8:11), a circle of stones that glows (8:2) and a green hill of peace (8:61).

acts.name: Walk on firm ground
acts.desc: Carry rain clouds over the dry sand; the ground turns firm and green.

9.concept: A small empty cave in the hills (9:40), a simple mosque on firm foundations (9:108-109) and a circle of stones for learning (9:122).

acts.name: Firm foundations
acts.desc: Carry four foundation stones to build on firm ground.

10.concept: A terrace of the moon's phases for counting the months (10:5), a ship at sea (10:22), a garden in the rain (10:24) and a doorway to Yunus's story (10:98).

acts.name: Count the months
acts.desc: Lay five numbered stones in order, counting as the moon does.

13.concept: The valley of thunder: rivers running between mountains (13:3), neighbouring plots growing different fruits from one water (13:4), a ridge and a rocky hall under thunder clouds (13:12-13) and a pool where foam drifts away (13:17).

acts.name: One water, many fruits
acts.desc: Plant three young trees side by side; they grow from the same water.

14.concept: A good tree with deep roots and high branches (14:24), an uprooted tree lying loose (14:26), a dry valley (14:37) and a river with sailing boats (14:32).

acts.name: Good words grow
acts.desc: Plant three saplings; each grows into a firm tree.

15.concept: A rocky tract under the stars: constellations (15:16), firm mountains (15:19), winds carrying pollen to flowers (15:22) and empty homes carved in the cliffs (15:82).

acts.name: Find the constellations
acts.desc: Find five bright stars low over the rocks.

acts.name: Carry the pollen
acts.desc: Carry pollen to three bare beds; they flower.

17.concept: A path of lamps through the night (17:1: nothing of the journey is depicted), two signs, the sun and the moon (17:12), a family courtyard (17:23) and a market with honest scales (17:35).

acts.name: Honest measure
acts.desc: Carry the weights to the scale and give full measure.
acts.label: full measure

19.concept: A quiet chamber (19:11), a tall palm in a remote place (19:23) with a stream below it (19:24) and ripe dates (19:25), and a mountain slope (19:52). No one is shown.

acts.name: The palm and the stream
acts.desc: Find five ripe dates fallen under the palms.

20.concept: A fire glowing far across a dark valley (20:10), a pair of sandals left at the valley's edge (20:12, an adaptation), a chest in the reeds (20:39), a dry path between walls of water (20:77) and an empty camp (20:88). Musa and every person are never shown; no idol is pictured.

acts.name: Follow the firelight
acts.desc: Lay five numbered stepping stones toward the distant fire.

21.concept: Rooms of signs: a spring (21:30), an empty ring of stones where the fire was made cool (21:69; no fire or person is shown), mountains with birds (21:79), a sail full of wind (21:81) and a dark sea at night (21:87).

acts.name: The orbits
acts.desc: Find four bright lights floating over the spring.

22.concept: Roads from far mountain passes with camels (22:27), simple foundations (22:26), dry fields that turn green as rain falls (22:63) and a slope where plants stir (22:5).

acts.name: Rain on the hills
acts.desc: Carry rain clouds over three dry fields; they turn green.

acts.name: Pack for the journey
acts.desc: Pack four sacks for the journey.

23.concept: Terraces of the successful believers: a quiet stepped terrace (23:2-3), rain held in great basins (23:18), palms and vines (23:19), a great olive tree (23:20) and an empty shipyard (23:27).

places.area: Terrace of Turning from Idle Talk

acts.name: Fill the reservoir
acts.desc: Carry four jars of rain water to the basins.

24.concept: Doors that open after greeting (24:27), a glass lamp in a niche like a bright star (24:35), a blessed olive grove (24:35), a mirage plain (24:39), a dark sea (24:40) and birds with spread wings (24:41).

acts.name: Layers of light
acts.desc: Carry three lamps to the niche: light upon light.
acts.label: the niche

25.concept: A sundial field where shadows move with the sun (25:45), winds driving clouds (25:48), two waters side by side with a barrier (25:53), the sun and the moon (25:61) and a gentle path (25:63).

acts.name: Bring the rain
acts.desc: Carry rain clouds over three dry fields.

26.concept: Seven shores: towering walls of water either side of a path (26:63), a meadow of many noble kinds (26:7), rock-cut homes, empty (26:149) and a thicket by a market with scales (26:176-183).

acts.name: Noble kinds
acts.desc: Plant three beds; each blooms with a different kind.

acts.name: Full measure
acts.desc: Carry the weights to the scale and give full measure.
acts.label: full measure

28.concept: Reeds and calm water (28:7), the well of Madyan with flocks waiting (28:23), a tree's shade (28:24), a fire seen from the road (28:29) and a treasure house sinking into the ground (28:81).

acts.name: Water the flock
acts.desc: Carry four jars from the well to the trough for the waiting flocks.
acts.label: trough

29.concept: A huge, fine spider's web (29:41), a road through many landscapes (29:20) and an ark resting on a ridge as a sign (29:15).

acts.name: Observe creation
acts.desc: Find five glowing things along the road.

30.concept: A market of many languages (30:22), a harbour with ships on good winds (30:46), clouds that spread and break into rain (30:48) and bare land returning to green (30:50).

acts.name: Wind and rain
acts.desc: Carry rain clouds over the bare land; it turns green.

31.concept: A great rock with a tiny seed beside it (31:16), a path for walking gently (31:19) and a shore with trees and a pen (31:27).

places.area: The Rock and the Mustard Seed

acts.name: Find the seed
acts.area: The Rock and the Mustard Seed
acts.desc: Find three tiny seeds hidden around the rock.

32.concept: A riverbank of clay (32:7), a village with lamps at night (32:16) and dry land receiving water (32:27).

acts.name: Water the plain
acts.desc: Carry rain clouds to the dry plain.

33.concept: Wind sweeping through empty tents (33:9) and mountains that stand for the trust (33:72, symbolic).

acts.name: Qualities wall
acts.desc: Carry five stones to build a wall of good qualities.

34.concept: Hills that echo with praise and birds (34:10), a glowing spring of copper (34:12), great basins (34:13), gardens on both sides of a dam (34:15) and a broken one where the trees fell (34:16).

acts.name: Work in gratitude
acts.desc: Carry four jars to fill the great basins.

35.concept: Mountains streaked white, red and black (35:27), orchards in many colours (35:27) and two seas, fresh and salt, with pearls (35:12).

acts.name: Colour hunt
acts.desc: Find five fruits fallen in the orchard.

acts.name: Pearl diving
acts.desc: Find four pearls by the two seas.

36.concept: Dead earth that bursts with grain (36:33), palms and springs (36:34), the moon's phases (36:39), a laden ship (36:41) and a green tree with a fire (36:80).

acts.name: Moon phases
acts.desc: Lay five numbered stones in order, as the moon passes through its stages.

acts.name: Pairs
acts.desc: Bring the animals to their pens in pairs.

37.concept: A sky adorned with stars (37:6), an open shore (37:145) and a gourd vine over a shady spot (37:146).

acts.name: Grow the vine
acts.desc: Plant three cuttings; a gourd vine grows over each.

38.concept: Hills that echo at sunrise (38:18), birds gathering (38:19) and a cool spring (38:42).

acts.name: Gather the birds
acts.desc: Bring four birds to gather together.
acts.label: assembled

39.concept: Rain running underground into springs (39:21), crops that grow, turn yellow and dry (39:21) and a soft light on the horizon (39:73; nothing of Paradise is pictured).

acts.name: Water cycle
acts.desc: Carry rain clouds over the fields.

40.concept: A brick tower that stops far short of the sky (40:36-37) and a simple house (40:28). No one is shown.

acts.name: The grazing animals
acts.desc: Bring the animals to their pens in pairs.

41.concept: A sky of drifting mist (41:11), a still dry plain (41:39) that stirs and sprouts when rain falls (41:39).

acts.name: Rain and growth
acts.desc: Carry rain clouds to the still earth; it stirs and grows.

42.concept: A harbour of ships like mountains (42:32), ships lying still when the wind stops (42:33) and a circle of seats for deciding together (42:38).

acts.name: Decide together
acts.desc: Carry baskets to the circle to share what was provided.
acts.label: share

43.concept: Roads across the earth (43:10), rain in measure reviving dead land (43:11), and ships and animals to ride (43:12).

acts.name: Rain in measure
acts.desc: Carry rain clouds to revive the dead land.

44.concept: A calm blessed night (44:3), a sea lying still (44:24) and gardens and springs left behind (44:25).

acts.name: Gardens and springs
acts.desc: Find four fruits still lying in the empty gardens.

45.concept: Ships sailing (45:12) and a wide view of sky and land, with birds and grazing animals (45:13).

acts.name: Winds
acts.desc: Carry rain clouds to the dry land.

46.concept: Wind-curved dunes (46:21), a cloud approaching the valleys (46:24) and a quiet night valley with standing stones (46:29; nothing unseen is shown).

acts.name: Kindness to parents
acts.desc: Carry water jars home for your parents.
acts.label: for parents

47.concept: A reading stand with the ayah that describes rivers (47:15; the rivers themselves are not pictured), a quiet garden and stepping stones for steady feet (47:7).

acts.name: Good deeds
acts.desc: Lay five numbered stones in order: feet planted firmly.

48.concept: A single tree on a plain, no one shown (48:18), and a shoot growing strong on its stalk (48:29).

acts.name: Grow the shoot
acts.desc: Plant three seeds; each sends out a shoot that grows strong.

50.concept: A sky without rifts (50:6), mountains and beautiful plants (50:7), blessed rain over grain (50:9) and lofty palms with layered fruit (50:10).

acts.name: Harvest
acts.desc: Plant three seeds of grain; the rain makes them grow.

51.concept: Winds scattering dust (51:1), clouds heavy with water (51:2), ships sailing easily (51:3) and a wide sky (51:47).

acts.name: Pairs
acts.desc: Bring the animals to their pens in pairs.

52.concept: A lone mountain (52:1), an open scroll on a stone (52:3) and a high sky (52:5).

acts.name: Oaths path
acts.desc: Lay six numbered stones in order, one for each of the first six ayahs.

53.concept: A star setting (53:1), a valley of sunshine and soft rain, standing for joy and tears (53:43; no faces) and the bright star Sirius (53:49).

acts.name: Find Sirius
acts.desc: Find the brightest star low over the hills.

54.concept: A full moon over the plain (54:1; the splitting itself is not pictured), pouring rain (54:11), springs bursting from the earth (54:12), a vessel of planks being built (54:13) and palms uprooted by the wind (54:20).

acts.name: Planks and nails
acts.desc: Carry four planks to the vessel being built.

56.concept: A field where seeds are planted (56:63), rain falling into a well (56:69) and a tree with a fire for travellers (56:72).

acts.name: Who grows it?
acts.desc: Plant three seeds and watch them grow.

acts.name: Fresh water
acts.desc: Carry three jars of fresh water.
acts.label: fresh water

57.concept: A field that grows and turns yellow (57:20), a forge with iron (57:25) and earth returning to life (57:17).

acts.name: Iron to the forge
acts.desc: Carry four bars of iron to the forge.

acts.name: Revived earth
acts.desc: Carry rain clouds to bring the earth back to life.

58.concept: An open hall where room is made for others (58:11), with seats in a circle and houses around.

acts.name: Make space
acts.desc: Carry six cushions to make room in the circle.
acts.label: make room

59.concept: A great mountain, humbled (59:21), and a reading stand with the ayahs of Allah's names (59:22-24; the names are read from the verified text, not drawn in the sky).

acts.name: Prefer others
acts.desc: Carry four baskets to give to others first.
acts.label: for others

60.concept: A bridge over a stream for fair dealings (60:8) and a garden of hope (60:7).

acts.name: Fair trade
acts.desc: Carry three baskets across, dealing fairly.
acts.label: fairly

61.concept: A wall of tightly joined stones (61:4).

acts.name: Build together
acts.desc: Carry six stones to build one firm wall.

62.concept: Market stalls shut for the Friday prayer (62:9) and reopened afterwards (62:10).

acts.name: Seek bounty
acts.desc: After the prayer, carry four baskets to the open stalls.

63.concept: Baskets of harvest to share before the time runs out (63:10).

acts.name: Share now
acts.desc: Carry four baskets to share now.
acts.label: share

64.concept: A path of steps up a slope, where effort counts (64:16).

acts.name: Do your best
acts.desc: Lay six numbered stones in order, one step at a time.

65.concept: A spring appearing in a dry place (65:3).

acts.name: Find the spring
acts.desc: Find three hidden springs of water in the dry land.

66.concept: A palace room (66:11) and a quiet sanctuary with fruit in a lit niche (66:12). No one is shown.

acts.name: Sincere repentance
acts.desc: Plant three beds as a fresh start; they bloom.

67.concept: A sky without flaw to look at again and again (67:3-4), slopes to walk (67:15) and birds with outspread wings (67:19).

acts.name: Bird watch
acts.desc: Find five birds resting on the ground.

acts.name: Walk the slopes
acts.desc: Lay five numbered stones up the slope.

68.concept: A pen and inkwell (68:1), a garden ready to harvest at dawn (68:17) and a garden that looks reaped (68:20).

acts.name: Share the harvest
acts.desc: Carry four baskets from the garden to share.
acts.label: share

69.concept: A windswept valley (69:6) with hollow palm trunks lying fallen (69:7).

acts.name: Remember and listen
acts.desc: Lay five numbered stones in order through the valley.

70.concept: Garden steps rising gently and a quiet place of steady prayer (70:23); nothing unseen is shown.

acts.name: Steady prayer
acts.desc: Lay five numbered stones in order, steady and constant.

72.concept: A still desert under the stars (72:1) and shooting stars across the sky (72:8). Nothing unseen is shown.

acts.name: Shooting stars
acts.desc: Find four bright stars low in the sky.

73.concept: A dial of the night hours (73:2-4) and a reading stand for slow, measured recitation (73:4).

acts.name: Divide the night
acts.desc: Lay four numbered stones in order, dividing the night.

74.concept: Sunrise over a home (74:2) and a washing place with clean cloth (74:4).

acts.name: Morning routine
acts.desc: Carry three jars of clean water to the washing place.
acts.label: wash

75.concept: A pattern of fingertip whorls in light on a stone (75:4).

acts.name: Fingerprint
acts.desc: Find four glowing whorls around the stone.

76.concept: An open doorway where food is shared (76:8).

acts.name: Share the meal
acts.desc: Carry three loaves to the open door to share.
acts.label: to share

77.concept: Winds in gusts (77:1), the earth that holds (77:25) and mountains with sweet water (77:27).

acts.name: Wind and water
acts.desc: Carry three jars of sweet water down from the spring.
acts.label: sweet water
